blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Accurate localization of the bronchoscope within the bronchial tree is essential for clinicians to be able to reach target lesions, perform biopsies and avoid misidentification of airway segments during diagnostic and therapeutic procedures. However, existing navigation systems typically rely on patient-specific CT scans or additional external sensors, increasing cost, setup time and patient radiation exposure. This work presents BronchoTop, a real-time, RGB-only framework for topological bronchoscopy localization that eliminates the need for patient-specific data. BronchoTop estimates scope location relative to a generic airway model through four modules: lumen detection and tracking, lumen-branch label association, probabilistic scope location estimation, and switch verification. By using only standard bronchoscopy video input, BronchoTop provides practical, real-time navigational assistance to physicians. Evaluation on phantom, simulated and real data demonstrates state-of-the-art accuracy, improving existing approaches performance by over 20% on real bronchoscopy sequences.
BronchoTop is the first published framework 1 1 1 https://sites.google.com/unizar.es/bronchotop including both the localization algorithms as well as all the real data used, together with code to generate additional simulations, encouraging and facilitating further developments and benchmarking. The results highlight BronchoTop’s potential to enhance procedural safety, efficiency and accessibility in clinical and robotic bronchoscopy.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Video bronchoscopy is a key diagnostic and therapeutic tool in respiratory medicine. It enables clinicians to visually explore the bronchial tree with a camera (bronchoscope) to detect potential lesions or tumors, biopsy them, or retrieve foreign objects.
blocks.zh: 视频支气管镜学是呼吸医学中的一个关键诊断和治疗工具. 它使临床医生能够用照相机(bronchoscope)直观地探索支气管树,以检测潜在的损伤或肿瘤,进行活检,或取回外来物体.

blocks.en: During the bronchoscopy, clinicians must mentally track the bronchoscope’s position through the complex tree-like structure of the airway (Figure 1 ) to locate potential regions of interest as they navigate through the airway. Misidentifying airway segments can lead to longer procedures and missed lesions, and navigational assistance systems could therefore prove essential to improve accuracy, efficiency [ 1 ] , and clinical outcomes [ 2 , 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 在支气管检查期间,临床医生必须通过气管复杂的树状结构(图1),在精神上跟踪支气管的位置,以便确定在空中航行时可能感兴趣的地区。 误用航道部分可能导致更长的程序和漏损,因此,导航协助系统对于提高准确性、效率[1]和临床结果[2、3]可能至关重要。

blocks.en:
Several techniques have been developed to address these challenges. Current navigation methods, such as Electromagnetic Navigation Bronchoscopy (ENB) [ 4 ] and Virtual Navigation Bronchoscopy (VNB) [ 5 ] , typically rely on pre-operative CT scans to obtain a 3D reconstruction of the patient’s airway, and external sensors (ENB) or image registration [ 6 ] (VNB) to track the bronchoscope through the 3D reconstruction during the procedure. To improve VNB performance, various methods combine depth inference with CT registration [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] , or include scope motion [ 10 , 11 ] or additional semantic information from the image [ 12 , 13 , 14 , 11 ] in an effort to improve registration.
Other approaches propose to use Simultaneous Localization And Mapping (SLAM) [ 15 , 16 ] to obtain a 3D reconstruction of the explored airway and register it to the patient specific CT scan, or use CNNs [ 17 ] and NeRFs [ 18 , 19 ] to estimate camera pose without registration to CT. While effective, these methods require additional hardware and patient-specific CT scans that increase patient radiation exposure and setup time.
blocks.zh:
为应对这些挑战,已经开发了几种技术。 目前的导航方法,如电磁导航气管镜(ENB)[4]和虚拟导航气管镜(VNB)[5],一般依靠操作前的CT扫描来获得病人的气道的3D重建,外部传感器(ENB)或图像注册[6](VNB)在程序期间通过3D重建来跟踪气管镜. 为了提高VNB的性能,各种方法将深度推论与CT注册[7,8,9]相结合,或包括范围运动[10,11]或图像中的额外语义信息[12,13,14,11],以努力改进注册.
其他方法建议使用同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)[15,16],以获得被探索的航道的3D重建并注册给患者特定的CT扫描,或者使用CNNs[17]和NERFs[18,19]来估计不注册CT的相机姿势. 这些方法虽然有效,但需要额外的硬件和针对病人的CT扫描,增加病人的辐射照射和设置时间.

blocks.en:
This work introduces BronchoTop, an online, RGB-only topological localization framework that provides real-time bronchoscopy navigation assistance without requiring patient-specific CT scans, or additional hardware. As illustrated in Figure 2 , our method estimates the scope location within a generic bronchial tree model shared across patients and relies only on the RGB bronchoscope video feed. Our evaluation shows BronchoTop’s significant improvements compared to existing approaches when run on real data without requiring any labeled topological location data.
BronchoTop relies largely on training-free structural tracking, with only one module requiring light easily obtainable supervision to estimate image similarity.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are the following: • We introduce a novel, image-only approach for online topological localization in bronchoscopy . Comprising of four modules (lumen detection and tracking, lumen-branch label association, scope location probability estimation, and location switch verification) our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on real bronchoscopy recordings. • We present the first publicly available dataset for bronchoscopy topological localization , releasing annotated real procedures and synthetic sequences to foster reproducibility and future research in this data-scarce domain. • We release our complete framework and trained models, enabling future benchmarking and the generation of new simulated data.

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Automatically localizing the scope as it traverses the organ being explored is a long studied, challenging problem due to the complex non-sequential structure of the bronchial tree.
blocks.zh: 由于支气管树结构复杂,在穿过被探索的器官时自动定位范围是一个长期研究的具有挑战性的问题.

blocks.en:
Conventional methods rely on auxiliary data and sensors, such as ENB [ 21 ] and VNB [ 22 ] , while image-only approaches often build dense 3D models using SLAM techniques [ 15 , 16 ] , or rely on CNN [ 17 ] and NeRFs [ 18 , 19 ] to obtain the camera pose.
However, accurate camera pose estimationis not always necessary, and topological localization often suffices for applications navigation assistance.
blocks.zh:
常规方法依赖于辅助数据和传感器,如ENB[21]和VNB[22],而仅图像方法往往使用SLAM技术[15,16]来构建密集的3D模型,或者依赖CNN[17]和NERFs[18,19]来获得相机姿势.
然而,准确的照相机并非总有必要进行估计,地形本地化往往足以帮助应用导航。

blocks.en:
Recent works propose to localize the bronchoscope by classifying each frame along the sequence as one of the possible locations, or places, within the bronchial tree.
For example, [ 23 ] and [ 24 ] apply supervised CNN models, such as EfficientNet [ 25 ] , ResNet50v2 [ 26 ] and DenseNet [ 27 ] for frame-wise classification in the initial levels of the tree. Similarly, [ 28 ] detects airway lumens using YOLOv7 [ 29 ] to deduce frame location based on the structure of the bronchial tree.
However, these approaches classify each frame individually and do not take into account the temporal aspect of a bronchoscopy procedure and its influence on the localization of the scope. Additionally, neither the trained models nor the large sets of labeled real bronchoscopy images used for training are public up to our knowledge.
blocks.zh:
近期的作品建议将支气管树内沿序列的每个框架分类为可能的位置之一,或位置,从而将支气管镜本地化.
例如,[23]和[24]应用有监督的CNN模型,如高效网[25],ResNet50v2[26]和DenseNet[27]在树的初始水平中用于帧式分类. 同样,[28]探测到使用YOLOv7[29]来根据支气管树的结构推导框架位置的气路路人.
然而,这些方法将每个框架单独分类,没有考虑到支气管镜检查程序的时间方面及其对范围本地化的影响。 此外,经过培训的模型和用于培训的、贴有标签的大型支气管镜像都不公开。

blocks.en:
To incorporate temporal dynamics, recent approaches track visible lumens to build exploration trees. For lumen detection, methods range from fitting ellipses to visible lumens [ 30 ] or using image gradients to detect lumen centers [ 31 ] , to depth-based strategies where depth-maps generate pseudo-labels [ 32 ] for Lite R-ASPP segmentation [ 33 ] or are thresholded to obtain lumen segmentations [ 34 , 35 ] after being generated using CycleGAN [ 36 ] .
By tracking these lumens, several works [ 34 , 35 , 37 , 38 , 30 ] dynamically generate a generic exploration tree. However, these relative trees lack direct correspondence to clinical anatomy, meaning they can identify branch depth but cannot differentiate specific nodes at each level, Right Main Bronchus (RMB) and Left Main Bronchus (LMB). Other methods [ 39 , 38 ] assign absolute labels by registering the exploration tree to a patient-specific pre-operative CT scan, as is already done for Virtual Bronchoscopic Navigation. While effective, the reliance on patient-specific CT scan limits their direct clinical applicability and introduces radiation exposure and setup overhead.
blocks.zh:
为了纳入时间动态,最近的方法跟踪可见的光芒,以建立勘探树。 就 Lumen 检测而言,方法范围从配位椭圆到可见的 lumen [30] 或使用图像梯度来检测 Lumen 中心 [31] ,到深度图生成Lite R-ASPP 分区的伪标签的深度策略 [32] 或者在使用 CycleGAN 生成后设定阈值以获得 Lumen 分区 [34,35] .
通过追踪这些月球,若干作品[34,35,37,38,30]动态生成一棵通用的探索树. 然而,这些相对的树木与临床解剖学缺乏直接的对应关系,这意味着它们能够识别分支深度,但无法区分每个级别上的特定节点,右主支线(RMB)和左主支线(LMB). 其他方法[39,38]通过注册勘探树来指定绝对标签给患者特定手术前的CT扫描,如同Virtual Bronchocographic Navigation已经做的那样. 依赖针对病人的CT扫描虽然有效,但限制了其直接临床适用性,并引入了辐射照射和设置间接费用.

blocks.en:
To overcome the need for patient-specific CT scans and generate exploration trees with clinical meaning, [ 40 ] localizes the scope within a generic, inter-patient model of the airway, as the airway structure has been proven similar enough up to the fourth branch level to do so [ 41 ] . This method uses a CNN (trained on k-means pseudo-labels from depth-maps [ 32 ] ) to compute location likelihoods. A Hidden Markov Model (HMM) then applies anatomical constraints to estimate the explored path. However, this approach is defined as an offline localization pipeline, and could not be used online, for navigational guidance during the procedure, due to the constraints and formulation of the HMM. For each sequence, the locations of the first and last frames (beginning and end locations) are required to compute each frame’s location.
This method shows good results in phantom data, but it has not been tested in real data.
blocks.zh:
为克服患者特异性CT扫描的需要,并产生具有临床意义的探险树,[40]将范围定位在通用的,住院间模式的航道内,因为航道结构已被证明足够类似到第四分支级别,可以做到[41]. 这种方法使用CNN(在k-意指深度地图上的伪标签[32])来计算位置概率. 然后一个隐藏的马尔科夫模型(HMM)应用解剖约束来估计探索路径. 然而,这种方法被定义为离线本地化管道,由于《有害和有毒物质管理条例》的限制和规定,无法在网上用于程序期间的导航指导。 对于每个序列,第一帧和最后一帧(起始和终点)的位置需要计算每个帧的位置。
这种方法在奇幻数据中显示出良好的效果,但还没有在真实数据中测试.

blocks.en: Our approach, BronchoTop, proposes an online topological localization method that relies exclusively on the RGB images captured by the bronchoscope. The localization is done within the same generic model of the bronchial tree used in [ 40 ] , removing the need for patient-specific CT scan, challenging registration techniques. BronchoTop allows for simplified and homogeneous identification of previously detected regions of interest in the case of follow-up procedures, and presents promising results on our released real procedure dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法,BronchoTop,提出了一种在线地形局部化方法,它完全依赖于由支气管捕获的RGB图像. 本地化是在[40]中使用的支气管树的同一种通用模型内完成的,从而不需要针对患者的CT扫描,挑战注册技术. 布朗乔 顶端可以简化和统一地识别先前发现的与后续程序有关的区域,并在我们公布的实际程序数据集方面提出有希望的结果。

blocks.en: III Method
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: We present BronchoTop, a novel pipeline for online topological bronchoscope localization with regard to a generic topological model of the bronchial tree. This clinically used airway topology model consists of 15 classes over 6 levels. An essential aspect of our approach is that it uses only the image data (frames) from the scope and does not require any external sensor or patient data.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍BronchoTop, 在线地表支气管局部化的新管道, 这种临床上使用的气道地形模型由6级以上15个等级组成. 我们方法的一个基本方面是,它只使用范围中的图像数据(框架),不需要任何外部传感器或病人数据。

blocks.en: III-A Lumen detection and tracking.
blocks.zh: III-A 卢门检测与跟踪.

blocks.en: The input to this module are the RGB frames. Each frame is first converted to grayscale, then K-means clustering (with K = 5 K=5 ) is applied to detect the visible lumens. As the lumens regions correspond to the furthest points from the camera, they generally form the cluster of the darkest pixels, with the lowest intensity. The detected lumens are then passed to an IoU-based multi-object tracker to track lumens across various frames. The IoU tracker used considers two detections as matched when the Intersection-over-Union (IoU) between their two bounding boxes is over 30%, as used in [ 39 ] . A tracked lumen is removed from the tracker if it is not detected for M t ​ r ​ a ​ c ​ k = 5 M_{track}=5 consecutive frames. Tracking makes the detection and overall pipeline more robust to noise, inherently present in bronchoscopy frames due to varying lighting conditions and possible presence of liquids. The output of this module is a list of all lumens tracked at a given time t, with corresponding bounding box coordinates.
blocks.zh: 这个模块的输入是RGB框架. 每个框架首先转换成灰色尺度,然后应用K-表示集群(含K=5 K=5)来检测可见的lumens. 由于lumens区域与相机最远的点相对应,它们一般形成最暗的像素群,强度最低. 检测到的Lumen随后被传递到一个基于IoU的多对象跟踪器,以跟踪跨越各种帧的Lumen. 所使用的IoU跟踪器认为,当其两个捆绑箱之间的交叉跨联盟(IoU)超过30%时,如[39]中使用的那样,两次检测是匹配的. 如果未检测到M t r a c k = 5 M QQ track 5 连续帧,则从跟踪器中移除一个履带路由. 跟踪使检测和整个管道对噪声更加有力,由于照明条件不同和可能存在液体,支气管镜框内固有的存在. 此模块的输出是在特定时间 t 上跟踪到的所有路门的列表,并附有相应的边框坐标.

blocks.en: III-B Lumen-Branch Label Association.
blocks.zh: III-B 卢门-布兰奇标签协会.

blocks.en:
This module’s input is the list of tracked lumens at time t t . At this stage,
each tracked lumen is assigned a label from the bronchial tree model. This label association is performed based on: 1) the location of the scope at instant t − 1 t-1 , 2) the lumens possibly visible at that location, and 3) the set of tracked lumens.
At a specific node in the tree, the visible lumens can be children of that node, or children of the node’s children (one level down, grandchildren). This fact defines the possible labels for the tracked lumens, included in the list of children and grandchildren of the previous scope location. Once the list of visible lumens is determined, the labels are assigned to tracked lumens based on the bounding box center coordinates of each tracked lumen.
Specifically, the tracked bounding boxes are ordered geometrically from left to right and assigned a label following the same order as in the bronchial tree model. This left-to-right assignment relies on the initial assumption that the bronchoscope enters the airway in an upright position. As the scope progresses and potentially rotates, its orientation might change, however this change is continuously captured and taken into account by the tracker.
To illustrate this process, Figure 3 shows the branch association process for two cases: when all visible lumens are children of the current node, and when visible lumens are a combination of children and grandchildren.

blocks.en:
Since lumen tracking can sporadically fail, the Switch Verification module verifies that a detected location change corresponds to a genuine transition rather than a sporadic detection or tracking error.
If P l ​ o ​ c , t P_{loc,t} indicates a possible location change, meaning arg ​ max k ∈ S t ​ r ​ e ​ e ⁡ P l ​ o ​ c , t ​ ( k ) ≠ S t − 1 , \operatorname*{arg\,max}_{k\in S^{tree}}P_{loc,t}(k)\not=S_{t-1}, the Switch Verification module compares the current frame I c ​ h ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ e I_{change} with the last frame I l ​ a ​ s ​ t I_{last} with a different number of active tracked lumens: • If forward motion, the last frame with at least two active tracked lumens (two tracked lumens with n l ​ o ​ s ​ t = 0 n_{lost}=0 ). • If backward motion, the last frame with one tracked lumen. The comparison is done using a lightweight siamese network consisting of three convolutional layers, and trained to compute similarity between frames with one and more than one lumen. If the difference between I c ​ h ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ e I_{change} and I l ​ a ​ s ​ t I_{last} is greater than a threshold (determined on a validation set of frames), the images are considered different enough and the location switch correct. If not, the system waits for n f n_{f} frames to re-evaluate the scene, and the probability updates are put on hold. If after the n f n_{f} frames the number of visible lumens is still the same than in I c ​ h ​ a ​ n ​ g ​ e I_{change} , the location change is considered valid. Otherwise, the location change is rejected and the previous location is maintained.
Therefore, the output of this module is the updated scope location probability if the location switch is valid, or the scope location probability from the previous frame, maintaining the same location, if the switch is not considered valid.
In our experiments, we empirically set n f = 10 n_{f}=10 frames, approximately 0.3 seconds of video at 30fps. This value was chosen to be long enough to bridge temporary tracking losses caused by motion blur or specular reflections, but short enough to prevent noticeable navigational lag.

blocks.en: IV BronchoTop dataset
blocks.zh: 四 布朗乔 顶级数据集

blocks.en:
Due to a lack of public annotated real data for this task, we collect and release a new benchmark for topological localization in bronchoscopy data, the BronchoTop dataset. It is a unique set that contains real and simulated bronchoscopy sequences with frame-level topological location labels provided by experts for each frame. It consists of three subsets: BronchoTop-Det , BronchoTop-Sim and BronchoTop-Real , summarized in Table I .
Frames from all our subsets have resolution 256x256. Figure 4 shows sample frames from each released set. • BronchoTop-Sim (Simulated) set: 9 simulated ( Sim1 - Sim9 ) sequences generated from CT-based 3D airway reconstructions of 2 patients, each containing 700 to 1000 frames. Sequences follow different paths down to branching level 4 (e.g., nodes TriLLB or LB4+5 in the airway tree model). Camera can only go forward, towards deeper levels.
Sequences are generated using Blender , and the framework is made available to generate additional sequences. • BronchoTop-Real set: 6 real ( Real1 - Real6 ) bronchoscopy sequences recorded during real procedures on 3 different patients, containing 505 to 1285 frames each. Sequences follow different paths down to branching level 3 (e.g., nodes BI or LLB6 in the airway tree model). Camera motion includes both forward-only and combined forward–backward trajectories. Sequences Real1 to Real4 have been labeled manually by doctors during the procedure, with one topological location label from the bronchial tree model assigned to each frame. Sequences Real5 and Real6 do not have corresponding topological location labels. • BronchoTop-Det (Detection) set: a limited set of 90 bronchoscopy images with manually defined ground-truth lumen detection bounding-boxes. Images are selected from sequences Real1 and Real2 of set BronchoTop-Real , with varying illumination and visibility conditions.

blocks.en: V Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 五 实验和结果

blocks.en:
This section presents the evaluation of BronchoTop on phantom, simulated, and real bronchoscopy sequences.
To incorporate reference results, we have implemented completely or partially (if the whole approach was not replicable) the most relevant related works. Since we could not find original implementations, we implemented the most relevant baselines found, with the required adaptations to run the online topological localization task on the public datasets considered.
blocks.zh:
本节介绍BronchoTop对幽灵,模拟,以及真支气管镜学序列的评价.
为了纳入参考结果,我们完全或部分地(如果整个办法无法复制)执行了最相关的工作。 由于我们无法找到最初的实施,我们实施了最相关的基线,并进行了必要的调整,以便在所考虑的公共数据集上执行在线地形定位任务。

blocks.en:
Our approach includes both original ingredients and modules that are common in existing related work pipelines ( Lumen detection and Tracking , module A, and Scope Location Probability Estimation , module C). We individually analyze the performance of our proposed implementation for modules A and C with respect to existing alternatives in the literature (experiments in Sections V-B and Section V-C ).
The validation of the steps that are specific to our pipeline (algorithm for Lumen-Branch Association , module B, and Switch Verification , module D) is run on the main experiment (Section V-D ). It compares the performance of our complete BronchoTop approach with the closest related work on topological localization in bronchoscopy.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法包括现有相关工作管道中常见的原始成分和模块(Lumen检测和跟踪单元A和范围地点概率估计单元C)。 我们根据文献中的现有备选办法(第五至B节和第五至C节的试验),分别分析我们拟议执行单元A和C的情况。
我们管道特有的步骤(Lumen-Branch协会的算法,模块B和Switch核查,模块D)的验证在主要实验上进行(第五节D节)。 它将我们完全的布朗乔托普方法的性能与支气管校正中最接近的地形定位相关工作进行比较.

IV ) and a publicly available phantom dataset [ 42 ] . These phantom sequences were obtained by manually navigating a camera through a physical phantom model of the airway. The phantom follows the same airway structure as our bronchial tree model in Figure 1 . blocks.en:
This experiment compares the topological localization results on all benchmarks for our full approach and the alternative strategy implemented as B4 , following [ 40 ] , the more complete alternative found that we could replicate based on existing related work. [ 40 ] trains a ResNet9 model on phantom training data [ 42 ] and combines it with a Bayesian temporal filter to compute the probability of each frame belonging to a node in the bronchial tree model based on the previous frames’ location. For fair comparison, we replace the original offline temporal filter (applied once the full sequence is available) with an online filter (ran as each new frame arrives).
The metric used in the following experiment is topological localization accuracy, defined as the percentage of total frames where the system’s predicted anatomical node matches the expert-annotated ground-truth, meaning nodes must be exactly identified, such as RMB or LLB6.
blocks.zh:
这个实验比较了所有基准的地形本地化结果, 用于我们的全面方法, [40] 在幽灵训练数据上训练一个ResNet9模型[42],并将其与贝叶斯时间滤波器结合,根据之前帧的位置计算支气管树模型中属于节点的每个帧的概率. 为了进行公平的比较,我们用一个在线过滤器(随着每个新帧的到来,随机数)取代原先的离线时间过滤器(一旦有完整的序列就应用).
以下实验中使用的度量衡是地形本地化精度,定义为系统预测的解剖结点与专家说明的地面真实性相匹配的总框架的百分比,意思是结点必须精确识别,如人民币或LLB6.

Table IV details the localization accuracy results of our method with and without Switch Verification module, against baseline B4.
Both BronchoTop variants significantly outperform B4 on BronchoTop-Sim and BronchoTop-Real. Although B4 achieves higher accuracy on the Phantom [ 42 ] dataset, this highlights a critical limitation of this baseline: its CNN classification module needs to be trained supervised on each target dataset. However, labels are expensive to obtain, and currently available only for Phantom data. Trained on Phantom data, it drastically fails to generalize to real data. In contrast, BronchoTop only requires labels to train the similarity siamese network, which are much easier to obtain.
Also, note that, while the Phantom train and test sets consist of different sequences, these sequences were captured using the same phantom airway, with the same appearance characteristics, as if it would correspond to a single patient, and B4 might overfit to this specific physical airway.
blocks.zh:
表四比照基线B4,详细列出我们采用或不采用开关核查模块的方法的本地化准确性结果。
BronchoTop两个变体在BronchoTop-Sim和BronchoTop-Real上都明显超过B4. 虽然B4在Phantom [42]数据集上实现了更高的精度,但这凸显了这一基线的关键局限性:其CNN分类模块需要在每个目标数据集上接受监督培训. 然而,标签的获得费用昂贵,目前只供幽灵数据使用。 在“幽灵”数据方面接受过培训,但无法将数据归纳为真实数据。 相比之下,BronchoTop只要求标签来训练相似度暹罗网络,这更容易获得.
另请注意,虽然幽灵列车和测试集由不同的序列组成,但这些序列是使用相同的幽灵气道捕捉的,其外观特征相同,仿佛与单个患者对应,而B4可能过于适合这个特定的物理气道.

blocks.en:
These results also highlight the significant improvements brought to our approach by incorporating the proposed Switch Verification (SV) module. When comparing our full pipeline BronchoTop (A+B+C+D) to its ablated version without the SV module (A+B+C), we observe an increase of 21% and comparable results across sequences.
These results indicate that the SV module is crucial for verifying suspected location changes before updating the scope’s position, and achieving robust, real-time bronchoscopy navigation.
blocks.zh:
这些结果还突出了通过纳入拟议的开关核查模块对我们的方法带来的重大改进。 在将我们的全管道BronchoTop(A+B+C+D)与没有SV模块(A+B+C)的减速版进行比较时,我们看到了21%的增量和各种序列的可比结果.
这些结果表明,SV模块对于在更新范围位置之前核实疑似位置变化以及实现稳健的实时支气管扫描导航至关重要。

Figure 6 presents additional qualitative results, illustrating the progression of the estimated scope location across the bronchial tree along sequences Sim2 and Real2 using BronchoTop with or without the SV module.
The diagrams show that the full BronchoTop approach is better adjusted to the ground-truth location than the simplified version of BronchoTop without module D. For example, in sequence Sim2, BronchoTop (A+B+C) switches from location LMB to location LLB6, which differs from the ground-truth, while the Switch Verification module is able to discard this potential switch and keep location LMB. Similarly, in sequence Real2, BronchoTop (A+B+C) switches from location LMB to location TRA while the Switch Verification module in BronchoTop discards this switch and maintains the correct location LMB.
blocks.zh:
图6提供了更多的定性结果,说明了使用有或无SV模块的BronchoTop,沿Sim2和Real2序列跨越支气管树的估计范围位置的进展。
图表显示,与没有模块D的BronchoTop简化版相比,BronchoTop完全的BronchoTop方法更好地调整到地面真实位置. 例如,在Sim2序列中,BronchoTop(A+B+C)从位置LMB切换到位置LLB6,这与地面真实性不同,而Switch验证模块能够丢弃这个潜在的切换并保留位置LMB. 同样,在Real2中,BronchoTop(A+B+C)从位置LMB切换到位置TRA,而BronchoTop中的Switch验证模块则抛弃了这个切换并维护正确的位置LMB.

blocks.en: These diagrams also highlight a limitation inherent to tracking-based methods. A single topological estimation error will propagate to subsequent predictions, even if future transitions are correctly detected. For example, in sequence Real2 (diagram (b)), BronchoTop (A+B+C) wrongly estimates location TRA instead of LMB. The next location switch detected is correct, but the location is estimated as LMB (one down from TRA) instead of LLB6. This would require manual correction by the clinician.
blocks.zh: 这些图表还突出了基于跟踪的方法固有的局限性。 单一的地貌估计误差会传播到以后的预测中,即使正确检测到未来的过渡. 例如,在序列Real2(diagram (b))中,BronchoTop(A+B+C)错误估计位置TRA而不是LMB. 检测到的下一个位置开关是正确的,但该位置被估算为LMB(一个从TRA向下)而不是LLB6. 这需要临床医生人工纠正。

blocks.en: VI Conclusions
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This work presented BronchoTop, the first real-time, RGB-only framework for topological localization in bronchoscopy. In contrast to existing navigation approaches that depend on patient-specific CT scans, additional sensors, or complex registration methods, BronchoTop leverages a generic bronchial tree model. Our four-stage pipeline, integrating lumen detection and tracking, lumen-branch label association, probabilistic scope location and a switch verification module, enables robust and efficient scope location estimation using clinical bronchoscopy video. Experimental results on phantom, simulated and real bronchoscopy sequences demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art localization accuracy, with significant improvements over existing baselines, while maintaining real-time performance. Additionnally, we release the BronchoTop dataset, the first public benchmark for topological localization, enabling reproducible evaluation and further work on the topic.
blocks.zh: 这部作品介绍了BronchoTop,这是第一个在支气管校正中进行地形局部化的实时,RGB唯一的框架. 与现有依赖于患者特异性的CT扫描,额外传感器,或复杂注册方法的导航方法不同,布朗乔托普利用通用支气管树模型. 我们的四级管线,结合了Lumen检测和跟踪,Lumen-branch标签协会,概率范围定位和一个开关验证模块,使得能够利用临床支气管镜镜像对范围位置进行有力有效的估计. 对幽灵,模拟和真实支气管扫描序列的实验结果表明,拟议方法实现了最先进的本地化精度,比现有基线有显著改进,同时保持实时性能. 此外,我们发布了BronchoTop数据集,这是地形本地化的第一个公共基准,能够进行可复制的评价和关于这一专题的进一步工作。

blocks.en: Future work will focus on extending BronchoTop to deeper, more-complex levels of the airway, as well as improving robustness to incorrect location changes and their influence on subsequent estimated locations, and exploring integration of BronchoTop to clinical and robotic bronchoscopy systems.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作将侧重于将BronchoTop扩展至更深,更复杂的航道水平,以及提高稳健度,以适应不正确的位置变化及其对随后估计位置的影响,并探索将BronchoTop与临床和机器人支气管镜学系统整合.
